title: God Files Refactor Phase 1 - Persistence Package Conversion And Narrow Service Contracts
goal: Convert app/persistence/story_development.py into a package with preserved public compatibility, extract backend persistence domains into owned modules, and move core services to narrow repository contracts without changing product behavior.

global_context.existing_capability_lock: Do not add new endpoints, new tables, new schema fields, or new product behaviors. This phase is architecture-only.

tasks.title: Add failing regression tests for the persistence package conversion and repository protocol surface
tasks.objective: Create failing tests that prove the future persistence package exports remain backward compatible and that the protocol module exists.
repo_context: The current import surface is app.persistence.story_development as a single Python module.
The target architecture requires app/persistence/story_development/ as a package while preserving current import paths for callers.

The contracts module must export PlanningRepository, BranchingRepository, ReviewRepository, DraftingRepository, GenerationRepository, ManuscriptAssistRepository, CanonRepository, and LibraryRepository.
implementation_notes: Write import-based tests that currently fail because the package modules and protocol exports do not exist.
Assert that importing app.persistence.story_development still exposes StoryDevelopmentRepository and representative record types after the package conversion.
Assert that importing app.persistence.story_development.contracts exposes the named protocol symbols.

verification.expected_red: FAIL because app.persistence.story_development is not yet a package and contracts.py does not exist

guardrails: Do not weaken or skip existing persistence tests.
Do not add placeholder asserts.
Do not use mocks; import the real modules.
tasks.review_before_complete: Read the test file and confirm every assertion locks an existing or explicitly designed surface from the architecture spec, not a speculative API.

tasks.title: Convert the monolithic persistence module into a package facade
tasks.objective: Replace the single-file module with a package-backed facade while preserving all current imports and runtime behavior.
repo_context: Python cannot keep app/persistence/story_development.py and app/persistence/story_development/ side by side as the same import target.
This task is the package conversion seam. Use a file move so the import target becomes app/persistence/story_development/__init__.py.
The moved facade must continue exporting StoryDevelopmentRepository and all currently imported record classes.
implementation_notes: Move the existing file contents to app/persistence/story_development/__init__.py.
Do not split behavior yet beyond what is necessary to make the package import target work.
Preserve current symbol exports exactly so the existing test suite can still import through the old path.

expected_green: story development persistence regression tests still pass

guardrails: Do not rename StoryDevelopmentRepository.
Do not remove record exports used by existing tests.
Do not begin logic extraction into submodules in this task.
tasks.review_before_complete: Review the new package facade and confirm it is still a compatibility layer only, not a partially rewritten domain split.

tasks.title: Create the narrow repository protocol definitions
tasks.objective: Define the focused repository contracts named in the architecture spec using only existing persistence capabilities.
repo_context: Target services include PlanningService, StoryBranchingService, ReviewRoutingService, DraftingService, ManuscriptAssistService, CanonCustomizationService, StoryGenerationOrchestrator, and GenerationGateService.
Protocols must describe current methods already implemented by StoryDevelopmentRepository; do not invent new persistence methods.
implementation_notes: Define method signatures for the existing methods each service actually uses.
Keep the protocols narrow and domain-scoped.

verification.expected_green: contracts module imports and named protocol symbols exist

guardrails: Do not define methods that do not already exist on StoryDevelopmentRepository.
Do not move runtime behavior into this file.
Do not introduce a new abstract base class hierarchy.
tasks.review_before_complete: Compare every protocol method against the real repository methods and remove any speculative or unused method names.

guardrails: Do not rename planning record types.
